items.text: Hello drafters,
We have released Patch 1.7.3 today which includes some fixes and adjustments.
Please note that this changelog will include spoilers for some rarer rooms and late game mechanics.
Fixed problematic spawn points for trophies in a few rooms (Showroom, Tunnel, and Pump Room)
Fixed the lighting on one of the books (ANC) in the library to make the coloring of the cover more consistent.
Fixed a collider issue on the checkout card in one of the books (ANC).
Fixed a few problematic colliders that made some dig spots in the house harder to trigger.
Added a collider to prevent a desk drawer from being clicked on from the wrong side of the desk.
Added a safety collider in the basement to prevent players from accidentally clipping through the floor while operating heavy machinery.
Restored the right-mouse icon to the above action UI.
Adjusted a few colliders in the basement to prevent a narrow softlock.
Fixed a softlock that occurred when digging up a buried hint after earning a trophy but not actually picking it up.
Fixed a large number of corner-case bugs associated with the mechanics of one of Guest Bedroom’s upgraded floorplans.
Adjusted the pages in a letter found in the Study to make page turning more intuitive.
Fixed a very rare bug that would result in the Toolshed appearing to only contain one item.
Fixed an oversight that caused a blue item to not spawn when its room was drafted as an outer room.
Three Day Blessing of the Tinkerer and Chef gold amounts have been swapped to correctly align their intended blessing thresholds. (This will align with the higher tiers now.)
The list of blessings printed in an issue of Drafting Strategy has been reordered and reformatted.
Finally fixed an elusive bug that prevented the Kennel’s effect from working correctly in The Foundation.
The below changelog includes challenge mode related and other game mechanics and bugs that players will not typically encounter through regular play.
Fixed a troublesome bug in Dare Mode that sometimes failed a certain dare involving red rooms when the player used Secret Garden Key or a similar special key (or a berry) while drafting.
Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the fourth dare presented to the player to be blank.
Fixed an unintended issue that only flagged the player as having ‘been cursed’ after reading the curse description in the menu. It now sets the flag correctly.
A certain in-game timer (utilized by players that play on dare and curse mode and other speed challenges) now doesn’t begin until the player has begun moving on day one.

Addressed several raycast and UI button issues that sometimes caused major bugs when fast clicking in UI menus. This fixed several issues including misaligned inputs (different buttons/floorplans are pressed than the one you clicked), softlocks and glitches within the Drafting UI, Basement Door UI, Regular Door UI, and other ‘Use a key’ UIs.
Fixed a bug causing the hand cursor to persist beyond drafting after selecting a floorplan quickly.
Fixed an issue that caused HLC to inadvertently be removed from the Draft Pool under certain circumstances.
Fixed an issue that could unintentionally make Workshop less common after an item interaction under certain circumstances.
The Armory is no longer incorrectly categorized as a gem room when you begin the day with Mantle of the Knight.
The patch is now live on Steam and will be available for Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch 2 players soon.
If you would be interested in helping us test upcoming patches we have a designated space for this in the Laboratory section of our Discord server.

Good Day Drafters,
Blue Prince’s Patch 1.7 is now available! (Console and Mac players should expect to see this update next week.)
This patch includes our accessibility update alongside a number of fixes for issues reported from the community.
1.7 marks the completion of a large rollout of accessibility features. These features can be accessed via the Accessibility menu and include:

Color Assist - A set of tools to provide color clarity to players who have trouble distinguishing some specific colors in the game. In addition to making puzzle colors a bit more vivid, we have also included separate systems to display color patterns, and an even more robust system that displays color labels for objects of inquiry.
Remapping - Yes! Key/button remapping is now supported for both keyboard and controller.
Cursor Set - Options for changing the opacity, style, and size of the game’s reticle and cursor (this is part of our new Motion Assist options.)

Invert Stroll - This is a feature that will allow players to invert the stroll button functionality. Inverting this means you will move at the faster stroll speed without needing to press/hold a button, and pressing/holding the stroll button will slow you down to a walk.

Motion Assist - A consolidated menu of features and settings aimed to reduce motion sickness and sensory conflict: Cursor/Reticle Settings, Look Sensitivity, Field of View, Smooth Look, and Stairs Skip (visually turn off spiral staircase travel.) Each feature is included along with our recommended setting adjustments.
The patch notes below will include spoilers for some rarer rooms and mechanics.
We have updated the save file architecture again on PS5 to further address an issue with some save files exceeding size limits.
As part of the Cursor features implemented above, we have redone the way the system handles changing cursors for a smoother visual experience when drafting, picking up items etc.
Fixed several visual bugs in the Precipice involving geometry from other areas clipping into the area from certain vantage points.
Fixed some colliders in the Casino causing players to inadvertently exit a UI screen while trying to pull a lever.
Added redundant safety checks to avoid potential soft locks that have been reported to occur within the above UI system.
Fixed an issue that was occasionally displaying a phantom Upgrade Disk in the Security terminal list for some players.

Slightly adjusted some factors related to the way Upgrade Disk floorplans are randomly selected to allow for greater variety during challenge runs while simultaneously making it less likely for new players from getting offered upgrades for rooms they have never drafted.
Fixed several bugs related to Powered Duct animations which restored spinning ducts to several rooms. Changing the direction of power in the Boiler Room also no longer breaks these animations.
Fixed several routing related bugs that could cause certain details and areas of the grounds and house to not be visible when approaching from certain areas.
Fixed an animation glitch caused by pressing buttons in the Chamber of Mirrors a bit too quickly that led to unexpected panel behaviour.

Fixed a handful of issues that were previously preventing floorplans from being duplicated by Chamber of Mirrors (some rooms are still excluded for technical reasons but the list is now more extensive.)
Related to the above - the experimental trigger related to terminal access has been reworked to correctly deal with duplicated terminal rooms.
A stamp in the Mail Room no longer disappears during magnification when a letter is in the foreground.
Fixed a bug that shut the book whenever you would click on the checkout card of A New Clue instead of inspecting it.
Fixed a bug that was unintentionally increasing the likelihood of drawing a non-green room in addition to the intended Green Rooms after Greenhouse had been drafted.
Fixed a bug with a particular locker in locker room that was occasionally not reacting to interaction.
Fixed a UI typo of “Bedroom” in an item description.
Fixed a text mesh bug that was not rendering asterisks correctly on a late grade chalkboard.
Updated templating of Observatory’s floorplan text to be more technically accurate and consistent with the game’s templating. (The floorplan now simply has the text “+1 star”)
Fixed incorrect layer assignments on a few more textures causing them to not be rendered when viewed through the magnifying glass.
Added more descriptive clarity for rarity in the wrench UI during first time use.

Notes

No gameplay changes or new features are included, this is a targeted security release.
If you're playing via Steam, note that Valve has also deployed client side updates related to this issue.

Hello everyone,
We have released patch 1.6 this afternoon for Steam players. This patch addresses a number of issues reported by the community. This update should be available on consoles within a week or two.
The changelog below may include spoilers for some rarer rooms and mechanics.
Patch 1.6 changelog

Added ability to manually “restore from backup” to the save menu. This is the same redundant safety system that was implemented in patch 1.5 to automatically restore a backup save in case of file corruption. Manual restoration may be useful for edge cases in which the main file is overwritten but not corrupted (one example may be a platform based cloud save conflict that was resolved incorrectly.) This feature can be found in the Save Menu.
Fixed a softlock that would occur when attempting to use a certain special key in the Vestibule .
In the Conservatory , controller support now works as intended while resetting rarity using the Room Directory .

Fixed a bug that has eluded us for a long time that was unintentionally preventing something rare being dug up from dig spots. (A scrap of paper containing a hint for contraption components.) This scrap can only be dug up in a save file where the contraption has not been built and it will only have a chance of appearing later in the game. Dig spot odds have also been subtly adjusted to ensure that this fix does not worsen item discovery or trash chances.
Fixed a rare bug that would occasionally allow an extra classroom to appear in the draft pool after all classrooms in the draft pool had already been drafted.
Fixed a bug that was preventing one of the default classrooms to be drafted in corner and edge locations in the house.
Fixed a few other rare issues preventing some rooms from unintentionally being unable to be drafted in certain locations in the house.
Fixed a bug that would sometimes offer players a “blank” reward in the Chamber of Mirrors .
Safety mechanism put in place to prevent a bug that was resulting in some players encountering three blank parlor boxes.
Fixed bug causing some items in certain classrooms to spawn offset from its desk.
Fixed a bug causing the metal detector to continue beeping after picking up a key in the Laundry Room.
Fixed a bug causing the metal detector to continue beeping after picking up the Key of A**** .
Audio added for SD raising event.
Fixed a narrow issue in which Greenhouse would sometimes be inadvertently removed from the draft pool while drafting south in the West Wing.
Fixed a bug with Commissary Special Orders that could delay some special orders from fulfilling.
Fixed a few discrepancies in the Commissary's listed sale prices and signs.
Typo for “features” fixed in Drafting Strategy Vol 2
Fixed a typo caused by hyphenation in Drafting Strategy Vol 5
Adjusted some details in the final exam’s first question to be more geographically clear.
Typo for “Synka” fixed in a terminal message related to packet transfers.
Changed a component in a grid that was mathematically inconsistent.
Fixed a regional character issue preventing repellent to work correctly in the Foundation for players in some regions.
And lastly,
Fixed a recently introduced bug resulting in The Foundation sometimes not appearing at the beginning of the day.

We wanted to clean up our versioning scheme to align a bit more with Patch 1.10 which will be the tenth and final major patch to the game. We didn’t want this patch numerically mistaken for Patch 1.1 which now designates the first patch of the game, so major patches will proceed very logically in sequence - 1.5, 1.6, 1.7 etc. while minor patches and hotfixes will use a third patch number such as our last hotfix which was 1.5.1.
Thank you to everyone for your careful and diligent reporting of issues and bugs — it makes a huge difference

Hello drafters,
We have released patch 1.5 this afternoon for Steam players. This patch addresses a number of issues reported by the community. Save Corruption & Loading Freeze Fixes

We've identified and addressed several edge cases that were causing save file corruption, resulting in a loading freeze when accessing the main menu. Unfortunately, if your save file was affected by these issues, we are sorry to say that means it is corrupted and irretrievable despite our best efforts to find a way to restore it.

This update also includes multiple fixes aimed at preventing these corruption cases from occurring in the future. Several code checks have been added to reduce the chance of corruption including redundant checking of the validity of the save before writing it. Additionally, we’ve implemented an automatic backup system: if the primary save becomes corrupted or lost, a backup save will now load instead. If you are PS Plus user whose save file has been affected by this, we have had a few encouraging reports from users who were able to restore a backup of their save file via Playstation Plus cloud storage. To restore from cloud on PS5 follow these steps:
1. Go to Settings > Saved Data and Game/App Settings.
2. Select Saved Data (PS5).
3. Choose Download or Delete from Cloud Storage.
4. Select the game and then the specific save file you want to restore.
5. Choose Download.

We are also currently implementing an “IMPORT TROPHY DATA” feature to work with platform achievements that had been previously earned in previous save files (even if they don’t exist in any of your current save files.) This feature will be included in an upcoming patch.

We have released a patch this afternoon to resolve some issues that the community have been experiencing. The patch is now live on Steam and we expect Xbox and PlayStation players to see this before the weekend. As always, the changelog below includes some spoilers.
This patch also includes a fix for the PS5 Save Rollback Issue that was preventing players from progressing their explorations of Mount Holly.

This issue was caused by a duplication of save data causing new save information to time out and not be saved. This problem has now been addressed and players should have no issues progressing and saving the game past the point where the bug was initially encountered.

We have worked tirelessly with Sony to avoid any save files being lost once the game patches.However, content that was not saved during the Rollback Issue has unfortunately been lost. Players should be able to return to Mount Holly at the point where they encountered the bug.

We would also like to add that we are currently working on a feature to use the Blackbridge Terminal’s “IMPORT TROPHY DATA” feature to work with platform achievements that have been previously earned (even if they don’t exist in any of your current save files.) We expect this feature to be completed soon and will be included in an upcoming patch, thank you for your patience.

It had always been my dream to release a definitive version of the game at launch. I’m a big fan of complete standalone experiences and it was never my plan to continually tinker with the game with regular content updates, room rebalancing, or DLC and the like. Considering this is my first game, I’m extremely proud of everything I managed to include for launch, but there are a few minor things that were not quite completed before our release date that I feel must be added to fulfill that original vision
Those inclusions will be added in 1.10, which will be the final major update to the game. It will be the definitive version of the game.

Among the planned inclusions in this final update: an overhyped arcade game, a curious house cat, accessibility features like color assist mode, controls remapping, cursor size/opacity settings, and widescreen support. Some UI/UX improvements, more variations for end-of-day manor descriptions and accompanying house illustrations, HUD display customization, final room/item balancing, and the addition of a handful of extra cinematics that I am still working on (the unlockable challenge modes actually have their own unique openings and endings!)

NOTE: We will continue to release bug-fixing patches intermittently in the months leading up to 1.10 and some of these updates may preemptively roll out some of the above-mentioned features (we wouldn’t want to sit on accessibility features for months on end while we wait on cinematics!) And while 1.10 will be the last planned content update, we will, of course, continually be committed to fixing bugs for far, far into the future.

Hello Drafters,

We've implemented the much requested Y-axis Invert as well as an option to turn "Smooth Look" off. You'll find both of these options in the 'Mouse Settings' (or 'Look Settings' if you are using controller) from the System Menu in the game.
You may also notice a new FOV slider in that same menu which is not quite usable yet (it not make this patch as it was unexpectedly causing some issues with UI elements, so it needs a bit more work.
A few minor text bugs that had been reported have been fixed, like Sinclair's Signature in the entrance letter not rendering under Magnifying glass .
Lastly, overlooked exploits that were allowing players to reach content beyond the scope of the demo has been removed. This was done principally with the removal of the S _ r _ _ e floorplan.
Thank you for your continued support of the Blue Prince Demo.
